stages.request: Please implement a wheel of fortune website where users can spin the wheel to win prizes. The website should have functionalities for spinning the wheel, displaying prizes, and recording user winning records. Users should be able to spin the wheel, view the prize list, view their own winning records. Use light gray as the default background and dark red for component styling.

cases.task: Spin the wheel to initiate a gameplay session.
cases.expected: The wheel spins, stops at a segment, and displays the prize won without any errors.

cases.task: View the list of available prizes before spinning the wheel.
cases.expected: A complete and accurate list of prizes is displayed, matching the set prizes available on the wheel.

cases.task: After spinning the wheel, navigate to the section displaying user winning records.
cases.expected: The user's winning record is updated to include the latest prize won, with correct details on date and prize.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'light gray' as the background color and 'dark red' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'light gray' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark red', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 1 for the existing wheel of fortune website in this directory (changes to existing behaviour, not new features).

1. Change the color theme: use 'ivory' as the default background color and 'dark green' for component styling (buttons, cards, headers), replacing light gray / dark red everywhere.
2. Spinning now requires the player's name: a required text field next to the spin control; spinning with an empty name shows a validation message and does not spin. Every winning record must show the player's name together with the prize and the date (existing records views included).

Keep all other existing functionality (prize list, winning records) working.

cases.task: Enter the player name 'Alice' and spin the wheel.
cases.expected: The wheel spins, stops at a segment and displays the prize won for Alice without errors. Spinning with the name field empty is refused with a validation message and the wheel does not spin.

cases.task: View the list of available prizes before spinning the wheel.
cases.expected: A complete and accurate list of prizes is displayed, matching the set prizes available on the wheel.

cases.task: After spinning as 'Alice', open the winning records.
cases.expected: The record list shows Alice's new win with the player name 'Alice', the prize and the date.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'ivory' as the background color and 'dark green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'ivory' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 2 for the existing wheel of fortune website in this directory (a change to existing wording, not a new feature).

Rename the concept 'prize' to 'reward' everywhere the user can see it: navigation labels, page titles and headings, buttons, table headers, messages (for example 'You won: ...' texts, 'No prize' texts) and the winning records. The word 'prize' / 'prizes' must not appear anywhere in the user interface any more. Behaviour stays the same.

Keep all other existing functionality (name required to spin, records with player name, the ivory / dark green theme) working.

cases.task: Enter the player name 'Alice' and spin the wheel.
cases.expected: The wheel spins, stops at a segment and displays the reward won for Alice without errors. Spinning with the name field empty is refused with a validation message and the wheel does not spin.

cases.task: View the list of available rewards before spinning the wheel.
cases.expected: A complete and accurate list of rewards is displayed, matching the set rewards available on the wheel.

cases.task: After spinning as 'Alice', open the winning records.
cases.expected: The record list shows Alice's new win with the player name 'Alice', the reward and the date.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'ivory' as the background color and 'dark green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'ivory' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

cases.task: Open every main page (spin page, reward list, winning records) and read all visible text, navigation labels, headings, buttons and messages.
cases.expected: The word 'prize' (and its plural) no longer appears anywhere; the concept is called 'reward' everywhere (navigation, headings, buttons, messages), and the pages still work.

stages.request: Please implement a polls website for users to cast their votes. The website should have functionalities for voting and viewing voting results. Users should be able to browse different voting options, cast votes for selected options, and view voting results. Color the background using white and set component styles to navy.

cases.task: Test the navigation to the voting page from the homepage.
cases.expected: The user can navigate to the voting page without errors, and all voting options are displayed.

cases.task: Check the ability to browse different voting options without casting a vote.
cases.expected: The user can view a list of voting options, and each option should be clearly displayed with relevant information.

cases.task: Test the voting functionality by casting a vote on a selected option.
cases.expected: The vote is successfully recorded, and the user receives a confirmation notification indicating that their vote has been cast.

cases.task: Check the voting results page for the display of current voting results.
cases.expected: The user can view the up-to-date voting results, including relevant statistics or graphical representations.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'navy', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request: Please implement a species biological information database website for displaying and managing biological information data. The website should have functionalities for browsing, searching, and filtering. Users should be able to browse biological information data for different species, search for specific data, and filter data based on different criteria. Specify linen as the base color and maroon for all components.

cases.task: Browse the database for available biological information of different species.
cases.expected: The user should be able to view a list of species with corresponding biological information without any missing data or display errors.

cases.task: Perform a search for a specific species using the search functionality.
cases.expected: The search results should display only the species that match the search criteria, demonstrating accuracy and relevance without results from unrelated species.

cases.task: Apply a filter to the data based on a given criterion (e.g., habitat type).
cases.expected: The data should update to show only those entries that meet the filter criteria, without displaying entries that do not match.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'linen' as the background color and 'maroon' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'linen' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'maroon', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 1 for the existing species biological information database website in this directory (changes to existing behaviour, not new features).

1. Change the color theme: use 'honeydew' as the base (background) color and 'dark olive green' for all components, replacing linen / maroon everywhere.
2. The search now matches the species name only (common or scientific name). Words that appear only in the habitat, diet or description must not produce results any more. Filters keep working as before.

Keep all other existing functionality (browse, filter) working.

cases.task: Browse the database for available biological information of different species.
cases.expected: The user should be able to view a list of species with corresponding biological information without any missing data or display errors.

cases.task: Search for a species by part of its name, then search for a word that appears only in a habitat or description (for example the habitat name).
cases.expected: The name search returns only the matching species; the habitat/description word returns no results, because the search now matches the species name only.

cases.task: Apply a filter to the data based on a given criterion (e.g., habitat type).
cases.expected: The data should update to show only those entries that meet the filter criteria, without displaying entries that do not match.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'honeydew' as the background color and 'dark olive green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'honeydew' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark olive green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 2 for the existing species biological information database website in this directory (a change to existing wording, not a new feature).

Rename the concept 'species' to 'organism' everywhere the user can see it: navigation labels, page titles and headings, table headers, buttons, filter labels and messages. The word 'species' must not appear anywhere in the user interface any more. Behaviour stays the same.

Keep all other existing functionality (browse, name-only search, filters, the honeydew / dark olive green theme) working.

cases.task: Browse the database for available biological information of different organism.
cases.expected: The user should be able to view a list of organisms with corresponding biological information without any missing data or display errors.

cases.task: Search for a organism by part of its name, then search for a word that appears only in a habitat or description (for example the habitat name).
cases.expected: The name search returns only the matching organisms; the habitat/description word returns no results, because the search now matches the organisms name only.

cases.task: Apply a filter to the data based on a given criterion (e.g., habitat type).
cases.expected: The data should update to show only those entries that meet the filter criteria, without displaying entries that do not match.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'honeydew' as the background color and 'dark olive green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'honeydew' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark olive green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

cases.task: Open every main page (browse list, search results, filter area, detail pages) and read all visible text, navigation labels, headings, buttons and messages.

stages.request: Please implement a barber shop management website for managing barbers and services. The website should have functionalities for adding barbers, services, and sending WhatsApp notifications. Users should be able to browse barbers and services, add new barbers and services, and send notifications to clients. Style the layout with snow in the background and dim gray for the interface.

cases.task: Add a new barber using the provided form with valid information.
cases.expected: The barber should be successfully added, and a confirmation message should appear. The new barber should be visible in the barber list.

cases.task: Add a new service using the provided form with valid details.
cases.expected: The service should be successfully added, and a confirmation message should appear. The new service should be listed under available services.

cases.task: Navigate through the website from the dashboard to the barbers and services section using a navigation menu.
cases.expected: Each navigation action should lead to the correct page without errors, maintaining a consistent and intuitive navigation experience.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'snow' as the background color and 'dim gray' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'snow' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dim gray', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 1 for the existing barber shop management website in this directory (changes to existing behaviour, not new features).

1. Change the color theme: use 'alice blue' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' for the interface components (buttons, cards, headers), replacing snow / dim gray everywhere.
2. Adding a barber now requires a phone number in the international form '+<country>-<number>' (for example '+81-90-1234-5678'); any other form is rejected with a validation message and the barber is not added. The phone number is shown in the barber list.

Keep all other existing functionality (services, notifications, navigation) working.

cases.task: Add a new barber using the form, first with the phone number '12345', then with the phone number '+81-90-1234-5678'.
cases.expected: The first attempt is rejected with a validation message about the phone number format; the second is accepted with a confirmation message, and the new barber (with the phone number) is visible in the barber list.

cases.task: Add a new service using the provided form with valid details.
cases.expected: The service should be successfully added, and a confirmation message should appear. The new service should be listed under available services.

cases.task: Navigate through the website from the dashboard to the barbers and services section using a navigation menu.
cases.expected: Each navigation action should lead to the correct page without errors, maintaining a consistent and intuitive navigation experience.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'alice blue' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'alice blue' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark slate blue', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:

Rename the concept 'barber' to 'stylist' everywhere the user can see it: navigation labels, page titles and headings, form labels, buttons, table headers and messages. The word 'barber' / 'barbers' must not appear anywhere in the user interface any more (the shop name may keep 'Barber Shop' in the site title only). Behaviour stays the same.

cases.task: Add a new service using the provided form with valid details.

cases.task: Navigate through the website from the dashboard to the stylists and services section using a navigation menu.
cases.expected: Each navigation action should lead to the correct page without errors, maintaining a consistent and intuitive navigation experience.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'alice blue' as the background color and 'dark slate blue' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.

stages.request: Please implement a fitness tracking mini-program for users to record and manage their fitness activities. The mini-program should have functionalities such as a fitness leaderboard, exercise recording, fitness diary, and a fitness statistics homepage. Users should be able to browse and record their own exercises, view the leaderboard, write a fitness diary, and track their own fitness data. Apply white to the canvas background and navy to all visible components.

cases.task: Navigate to the fitness leaderboard page.
cases.expected: The leaderboard page displays a list of users ranked by fitness activity, and user can navigate away without issues.

cases.task: Record a new exercise activity.
cases.expected: Exercise activity is saved and visible under the user's exercise records without any discrepancies.

cases.task: Write and save a new entry in the fitness diary.
cases.expected: The new entry is saved successfully and is retrievable from the fitness diary section.

cases.task: View personal fitness statistics on the homepage.
cases.expected: An accurate summary of the user's recorded activities is displayed, reflecting the updated fitness stats.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'navy', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

stages.request:
Change request 1 for the existing fitness tracking mini-program in this directory (changes to existing behaviour, not new features).

1. Change the color theme: use 'mint cream' as the background color and 'dark green' for component styling (buttons, cards, headers), replacing white / navy everywhere.
2. Recording an exercise now requires a duration in minutes (a number greater than 0); a record without a valid duration is rejected with a validation message. The exercise records show the duration, and the statistics on the homepage include the total minutes.

Keep all other existing functionality (leaderboard, diary) working.

cases.task: Navigate to the fitness leaderboard page.
cases.expected: The leaderboard page displays a list of users ranked by fitness activity, and user can navigate away without issues.

cases.task: Record a new exercise activity, first without a duration, then with a duration of 30 minutes.
cases.expected: The record without a duration is rejected with a validation message; the record with 30 minutes is saved and appears in the user's exercise records showing the duration.

cases.task: Write and save a new entry in the fitness diary.
cases.expected: The new entry is saved successfully and is retrievable from the fitness diary section.

cases.task: View personal fitness statistics on the homepage after recording the 30-minute activity.
cases.expected: The summary includes the total minutes of exercise and reflects the newly recorded activity.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'mint cream' as the background color and 'dark green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'mint cream' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.
